info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Guideline Compliance Check API
info.description: The Guideline Compliance Check API provides a mechanism for verifying adherence to specified banking compliance guidelines. It allows users to evaluate the compliance status of specific entities or operations using a unique identifier. This API is particularly useful for regulators, compliance officers, and risk management teams who need to ensure that banking processes meet established guidelines. By providing rapid access to compliance data, it facilitates informed decision-making and risk assessment in the financial sector.

get.summary: Retrieve compliance guidelines for a specific resource
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch compliance guidelines associated with the resource identified by its ID. Utilize this to ensure adherence to applicable guidelines for resource management and compliance tracking.
